screw: Acquired SVLING fully threaded M5 x 0.8 x 50 mm, B0GHNQFZYR

observations.reported_fit: Resistance in some cases; turning the screw was needed to pass it.
Required turning the screw throughout insertion.

user_statements: 5.2 is my choice for all threaded pass throughs. Make it so.

On the 12 mm sample it pushed through fine, on the 40 mm sample I got some resistance in some cases and had to screw to get past it. On 5.1 I had to screw the whole time. I think with variability accounted for, 5.2 will be both the safest and the tightest, at least for the risk profile I want to tolerate right now.
scope: Qualitative user selection of nominal 5.2 mm printed M5 threaded pass-throughs from the identified PET-GF comparison. The 5.1 mm sample length, screw outside diameters, forces, repeated-cycle results and load capacity are not specified.
